correctness.rationale: Read all eight actual Git-source files and independently reconstructed the eight-blob Git tree SHA 3c937b2e8a4fb9446a7eaf9fb086efd0e98ae136. The RESULT and SLOGAN identify a specific finite 60-vertex unweighted truncated-icosahedral graph with inclusive graph-distance thresholds 2,3. Reimplemented face enumeration, independent greedy elementary collapses, spanning-tree triangle-relator elimination, oriented 116-triangle surface cycle, twenty signed eight-triangle octahedron cycles, exact integral chain transport and primitive-pivot checks. The independent collapse order (not the source checker order) yields 144 free pairs and a (60,246,208) two-core at r=2, and 3122 pairs and a (60,108,50) two-core at r=3; both have π1=1 and Euler characteristics 22 and 2. Exactly 802 and 6462 faces and H2 ranks 21 and 1 are independently recovered. At r=2 the twenty hexagon cycles admit exclusive ±1 triangle pivots absent from the other twenty classes, and the global cycle has an additional ±1 pivot, yielding a unit determinant 21×21 minor and hence an integral basis of H2. At r=3 the global 2-cycle transports to 50 ±1 triangles and generates the rank-one integral H2; hexagon cycles bound six-vertex simplices, giving kernel Z^20 and split surjectivity. The proof uses genuine free-face deformation retractions, elementary π1 deductions, integral Hurewicz and homological Whitehead; the finite computations exhaust this exact finite graph, not an infinite class.
